abstract: Assesses cargo deck reinforcement ratings, deck load distributions, and offshore station-keeping power requirements
system_message:
You are Offshore structural cargo surveyor (STRUC). You serve as the offshore structural cargo surveyor (STRUC), responsible for assessing cargo deck reinforcement ratings, deck load distributions, and offshore station-keeping power requirements, as well as reviewing pedestal crane proof-load testing records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Assesses cargo deck reinforcement ratings, deck load distributions, and offshore station-keeping power requirements（DECK）
information_points.content:
STRUC-DECK-43Z：For Caledonian Oceanic Logistics, structural assessment of the reinforced open cargo deck area designated for module stowage indicates a reinforced deck load bearing capacity of 35 t/m2 before structural yield. Field installation station-keeping power simulations across a 72-hour module transfer window under sea-state 4 conditions establish its standby dynamic positioning fuel consumption at 90.0 t of total fuel mass consumed by thrusters and generators.
STRUC-DECK-NJ1：Structural assessment of the reinforced open cargo deck area designated for module stowage confirms Nordic Pelagic Transporter has a reinforced deck load bearing capacity of 22 t/m2 based on maximum permissible uniform deck load pressure before structural yield. Station-keeping power simulations for a 72-hour module transfer window under sea-state 4 conditions determine its standby dynamic positioning fuel consumption is 90.0 t consumed by thrusters and generators during dynamic positioning.
STRUC-DECK-XC2：For Boreas Offshore Heavy Lift, structural assessment of the reinforced open cargo deck area designated for module stowage establishes a reinforced deck load bearing capacity of 25 t/m2, representing the maximum permissible uniform deck load pressure before structural yield. Power simulations for a projected 72-hour offshore module transfer window under sea-state 4 conditions calculate its standby dynamic positioning fuel consumption at 75.5 t consumed by thrusters and generators during dynamic positioning.

information_points.title: Pedestal crane proof-load testing（CRANE）
information_points.content:
STRUC-CRANE-ACX：According to cargo gear test certificates, Nordic Pelagic Transporter possesses an auxiliary crane safe working load of 60 t for its deck-mounted auxiliary service pedestal crane at maximum operating outreach radius.
STRUC-CRANE-2X0：Cargo gear test certification for Boreas Offshore Heavy Lift certifies its deck-mounted auxiliary service pedestal crane with an auxiliary crane safe working load of 80 t at maximum operating outreach radius.
STRUC-CRANE-SO5：Cargo gear test certification for Caledonian Oceanic Logistics verifies an auxiliary crane safe working load of 40 t for its deck-mounted auxiliary service pedestal crane at maximum outreach radius.
